clips.title: The story
paras: In Westfall, the Defias Brotherhood's thieves threaten the farms and roads. Gryan Stoutmantle sends you from Sentinel Hill east into Redridge to seek a contact who may know where they hide.

Westfall's harvests are gone, and bandits in red bandanas roam the land. Gryan Stoutmantle and the People's Militia hold Sentinel Hill under near-constant attack, but they do not know who directs their enemies. Stoutmantle knows that fighting stray looters will not save the region. He needs to find the cartel's inner circle and learn who commands it.

Gryan Stoutmantle sets aside military channels and Stormwind's absent nobles, and calls on someone he knows. He sends trusted adventurers east, past Elwynn and into the Redridge Mountains. In Lakeshire, a quiet village by the lake, Wiley the Black waits on the upper floor of the local inn. The rogue knows the underworld better than any militia captain, and may offer the first lead to the Brotherhood's hideouts.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The band of wretches responsible for driving the good people of Westfall from the land call themselves The Defias Brotherhood. I need you to infiltrate this clan of thugs. We need to know who heads up the cartel and where they are hiding out. In Lakeshire, in the inn, there is a rogue by the name of Wiley who owes me a favor.
Travel to Lakeshire in the Redridge Mountains, east of Elwynn, and find out what you can.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So, Stoutmantle sent you? Well, I owe him.
